D: Three lifelong friends spend one last wild Christmas Eve in New York hunting for a legendary party.
P: Serve the snacks when they head out into New York on Christmas Eve.
S: Christmas Eve on the streets of New York

Toasted mini bagels spread with chive cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, capers, red onion and fresh dill. Split 12 mini bagels and toast until golden. Beat 200g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped chives and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on each bagel half. Top with a ribbon of smoked salmon from 200g, a few capers, a sliver of red onion and a sprig of dill. Finish with cracked black pepper and serve on a board with lemon wedges.
Nutcracka hunt hot honey buffalo wings
the long night hunting for the Nutcracka Ball

Crisp oven-baked wings tossed in buttery hot sauce with a cool ranch dip, carrot and celery sticks. Pat 1.2kg chicken wings dry and toss with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 100ml hot sauce and 1 tbsp honey, then toss the wings through. For the ranch, mix 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 3 tbsp buttermilk, chopped chives and dill and garlic powder. Serve with carrot and celery sticks.
M: Little beef sliders and mac and cheese cups, the kind of party food you would hope to find at the most famous party in town.
W: the end of the night with the three friends
Soft sticky gingerbread cake with lemon icing, something sweet for when the night finally winds down.
K: a cold New York Christmas Eve

Red wine gently warmed with orange, cinnamon, star anise and cloves, sweetened with honey and served steaming in mugs with an orange slice. Pour 750ml red wine into a saucepan with 250ml orange juice, 3 tbsp honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 star anise, 6 cloves and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes, keeping it below a simmer so the alcohol stays. Ladle into 4 mugs with an orange slice each. For anyone not drinking, warm sparkling apple juice with the same spices.
